title: Reinforced Curriculum Pre-Alignment for Domain-Adaptive VLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on a novel post-training paradigm for adapting Vision-Language Models to specific domains such as medical imaging and geometry. Its evaluations are based on performance metrics for these technical tasks (BLEU, CIDEr, etc.) and general capabilities benchmarks (MMMU, IFEval), without any components related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
